name: Word art
description: 90s word art: chunky letters in a rainbow gradient that flows along them, skewed, with a deep 3D extrude growing out behind, set on a wave or an arch, spinning in with a bounce.

name: Reaction rain
description: Live-stream reactions floating up the side of the frame: emoji (or any glyphs or words) popping in at the bottom, wobbling as they rise and fading out near the top.

controls.d: 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Noto Color Emoji', 'Twemoji Mozilla', sans-serif

texts.name: font
texts.label: Font
texts.default: 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Noto Color Emoji', 'Twemoji Mozilla', sans-serif

name: Hitmarker montage
description: A montage-parody volley: hit markers slamming down one after another at points across the frame, a score popping up and floating off each, the frame jolting with every hit and the last one in red.

controls.d: Impact, Anton, 'Haettenschweiler', 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Arial Black', sans-serif

texts.name: font
texts.label: Font
texts.default: Impact, Anton, 'Haettenschweiler', 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Arial Black', sans-serif

name: Bonk
description: A cartoon mallet winds up and swings down onto a point, the head under it squashes and springs back, and a comic impact star pops with the word BONK, the frame shaking from the hit.

name: Error cascade
description: Retro error dialogs popping up one after another, cascading down the screen or dragging a trail across it like a frozen computer, each with an editable title, message and button and no real system's branding.

name: Stonks chart
description: The stonks trope: a jagged line chart rocketing up to a fat arrow head (or crashing down, by a switch), its value ticking up as it draws and a bold label above, laid over a picture or on its own.

controls.d: Impact, Anton, 'Haettenschweiler', 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Arial Black', sans-serif

texts.name: font
texts.label: Font
texts.default: Impact, Anton, 'Haettenschweiler', 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Arial Black', sans-serif

name: Deal with it
description: Pixel sunglasses sliding slowly down from the top of the frame onto a pair of eyes, landing with a little bounce, then a caption snapping on underneath.

controls.d: Impact, Anton, 'Haettenschweiler', 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Arial Black', sans-serif

texts.name: font
texts.label: Font
texts.default: Impact, Anton, 'Haettenschweiler', 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Arial Black', sans-serif

name: Impact caption
description: The classic meme caption: white Impact capitals with a heavy black outline across the top and bottom of the frame, each fitted to the width, popping on with the punchline a beat after the setup.

controls.d: Impact, Anton, 'Haettenschweiler', 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Arial Black', sans-serif

texts.name: font
texts.label: Font
texts.default: Impact, Anton, 'Haettenschweiler', 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Arial Black', sans-serif

name: To be continued
description: A picture that freezes on a sudden sepia grade with a little punch-in, then a left-pointing arrow slides in at the bottom with its words on it, holds, and it starts over.

name: Laser eyes
description: Laser beams firing from two eyes over a picture: a white-hot core in a red glow, flaring at each eye and flickering, aimed at any angle and spread, with the picture darkened behind them.

name: Dramatic zoom
description: A crash zoom onto a point (a face, a stare, a detail) in a few sudden steps, each landing with a kick while a vignette closes in, then a hold and a snap back to the whole picture.

name: Deep fried
description: A picture fried to a crisp: saturation and contrast blown out, posterised colour, oversharpened halos, JPEG blocking and grain, with red glints flaring from two points such as the eyes.

name: Pixel weather
description: A 16 × 16 pixel-art weather icon: a sun flicking its rays, partly cloudy, a bobbing cloud, rain or snow falling in steps, or a thunderbolt flashing under a dark cloud.

controls.l: Weather (sun, partly cloudy, cloudy, rain, thunder, snow)

name: Snake loader
description: A pixel snake running laps round the edge of a phone-LCD board a cell at a time, eating the food in its path, as a looping loader.

name: Pixel explosion
description: An 8-bit explosion: a white-hot pixel fireball swelling through yellow, orange and red into a ring of smoke, sparks flying out, frame by frame.

name: Pixel block wipe
description: An 8-bit block wipe: big squares grow in steps to cover the picture in a diagonal, spiral, closing-iris or random order, then shrink away to show the next one. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Screen melt
description: The classic shooter's screen melt: the old picture's columns slide down off the screen at ragged, staggered speeds, uncovering the next one. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: LED ticker
description: A dot-matrix LED sign with any text marching across it a column at a time, its lit dots glowing over the dim unlit ones, in a seamless loop.

name: RPG dialog
description: A role-playing game's text box: a pixel-bordered panel with a speaker's name tab slides up, the line types out letter by letter in a pixel font, and a continue arrow blinks.

controls.d: WELCOME, TRAVELLER! THE ROAD AHEAD IS DANGEROUS. TAKE THIS.

texts.name: text
texts.label: Text
texts.default: WELCOME, TRAVELLER! THE ROAD AHEAD IS DANGEROUS. TAKE THIS.

name: Pixel city
description: A night-time pixel skyline in parallax: three rows of towers with windows flicking on and off, blinking aerials, stars, a crescent moon and car lights along the street.
